meaning:
μυκτηρίζω
(μυκτήρ, the nose), [in LXX: 4Ki.19:21, Job.22:19, Psa.80:6, al. (לָעַג), Pro.1:30 (נָאַץ) Pro.15:20 (בָּזָה), 1Ma.7:34, al. ;]
to turn up the nose or sneer at, mock: pass., Gal.6:7 (cf. ἐκ-μυκτηρίζω).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Don’t be deceived. God is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap.
